_comment: Gates for `make eval-gate`. Set from measured values, not aspiration.
Fairness and soundness are zero-tolerance: a single violation means the score moved
for a reason the product promises it never uses, or moved in a direction that
contradicts the documented model. Those are defects, not budget.
The accuracy floors sit a little below current measurements so ordinary variation in
corpus growth does not fail the build, while a real regression does. Raise them when
the corpus grows; never lower one without recording why in the changelog.
